value.rationale: The 2026 source identifies quenched convergence as an open gap. The result proves it for the natural independent fair-coefficient case and, more substantively, quantifies the fluctuation mechanism with a sharp annealed rate 3, centered quenched rate 1, and an LIL obstruction to any uncentered quenched second-order limit. The exact Pascal transformation connects the specific model to tractable iid scenery, and this is structural rather than a routine finite table entry.
